combat1.name: Psyshkhwe Arietta
combat1.descriptionRaw:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Sings an ancient song of the Water Imps, unleashing up to 4 strikes. This deals <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG</color> to the opponent.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to hurl a water ball forward, dealing <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents along the path. Deals <color=#80C0FFFF>AoE Hydro DMG</color> upon impact with the ground.

combat2.name: Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn
combat2.descriptionRaw:
Reveals her true Water Imp form, dealing <color=#80C0FFFF>AoE Hydro DMG</color> and gaining the <color=#FFD780FF>Song of Ages Past</color> effect: While this effect is active, Vodyanitsa summons the ancient <color=#FFD780FF>Horn of Spring's Call</color>, periodically moving closer to an opponent in a swift movement to attack them, dealing <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG</color>.
The above two types of attacks will also decrease the <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro RES</color> and <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo RES</color> of opponents hit. Additionally, while the <color=#FFD780FF>Song of Ages Past</color> effect is active, the party's active character gains increased resistance to interruption and periodically regenerates HP based on Vodyanitsa's Max HP.

combat3.name: Koda: Sink With Thee
combat3.descriptionRaw:
Leads a song of the Water Imps which lures its listeners to their doom. This deals <color=#80C0FFFF>AoE Hydro DMG</color> to the opponent.
When in the <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11402}Song of Ages Past{/LINK}</color> state, DMG dealt is further increased.

passive1.name: The Last Djeguako Songstress
passive1.descriptionRaw:
When the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn</color> is used, any Stellar Vortex on the field will turn into a Wandering Vortex instead. While the <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11402}Song of Ages Past{/LINK}</color> effect is active, nearby party members' Stellar Swirl reactions will generate Wandering Vortex instead.
Generating or detonating a Wandering Vortex will also reduce nearby opponents' <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo RES</color> by 35% for 6s. 
Additionally, nearby party members who enter the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color> state while <color=#FFD780FF>Song of Ages Past</color> is in effect will have the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color> state extended by 4s.

passive2.name: Dirge of the Fandyr
passive2.descriptionRaw:
When the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn</color> is used, Vodyanitsa will also gain 25 stacks of {LINK#N11400001}<color=#FFD780FF>Lead Vocal</color>{/LINK} as well as 10 stacks of {LINK#N11400002}<color=#FFD780FF>Chorus</color>{/LINK}.
The two effects above last 30s each, and the stack count is refreshed when the Elemental Skill is used.

passive3.name: Echoes Over the Frozen Lake
passive3.descriptionRaw:
Holding the Elemental Skill outside of combat will cause Vodyanitsa to embody her true Water Imp form and swim for up to 10s at the cost of Stamina. Naturally, as a Water Imp, she can also move across the water's surface. Vodyanitsa will exit her Water Imp form when the Elemental Skill is used again, when the duration ends, or when all Stamina is depleted.
Additionally, while Vodyanitsa can swim faster, her Stamina consumption rate is also increased.
